self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: After using Plunge get 28% plunge crit dmg Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

After using skill get 40% plunge crit dmg Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A trophy made from gemstones from the Collective of Plenty and crystals from the Flower-Feather Clan. It is said to have once belonged to a legendary wrestler.

refinements.1: ATK is increased by <r>28%</r>. When you use a Plunging Attack, you will gain the "Dawn's First Hue" effect: Plunging Attack CRIT DMG is increased by <r>28%</r>. When you use an Elemental Skill or Burst, you will gain the "Twilight's Splendor" effect: Plunging Attack CRIT DMG is increased by <r>40%</r>. The two effects above each last for 15s, and will be canceled 0.1s after the ground impact hits a target.

fr.flavor: Un trophée fabriqué à partir des pierres précieuses du Collectif de l'abondance et des cristaux du Clan des fleurplumes. On dit qu'il a appartenu à un lutteur légendaire.

refinements.1: Augmente l'ATQ de <r>28 %</r>. De plus, utiliser une attaque plongeante accorde l'effet Teinte d'aube, augmentant les DGT CRIT des attaques plongeantes de <r>28 %</r>, tandis qu'utiliser une compétence élémentaire ou un déchaînement élémentaire accorde l'effet Splendeur d'aurore, augmentant les DGT CRIT des attaques plongeantes de <r>40 %</r>. Chacun de ces deux effets dure 15 s et prend fin 0,1 s après qu'un impact au sol touche.
